name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 42 2023
information: ### **There is no 3x3x3 Cube at this competition!** The main event is 3x3x3 Blindfolded. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may only bring two guests maximum. * Due to space limitations, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind will have a separate competitor limit.
